svg.title: Person (f)
svg.desc: Adult female human in a neutral anterior stance, wearing trousers rather than a symbolic skirt, with subtle shoulder, waist, and pelvic proportions. Design basis: Sex presentation is conveyed through restrained proportional and hair cues instead of restroom-sign conventions, keeping the figure appropriate for scientific graphics.
